definition: Showing exaggerated, sentimental emotion, often in a rather embarrassing way.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: “You don’t even know that a child was born of this maudlin pair; you don’t even know that.”
example_sentence: After midnight the karaoke turned maudlin.
